name: Santa Cruz del Retamar (Spain)
description: Vertically divided red and white, charged at the centre with the crowned arms of Santa Cruz del Retamar (a cross and a broom plant on white, a castle and stripes).
history: Municipal flag of Santa Cruz del Retamar; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Santa Cruz del Retamar arms — cross and broom plant on white, castle on yellow and stripes
castle and crown of the arms
